blocks.text: The Pathless Path: or, how to attain Śiva without doing a single bloody thing.
blocks.directed: The Pathless Path: or, how to attain Śiva without doing a single bloody thing.

blocks.text: Last chapter, we established that your true nature is Śiva.
blocks.directed: Last chapter, we established that your true nature is Śiva.

blocks.text: Infinite consciousness. Completely free. Absolutely sovereign.
blocks.directed: Infinite consciousness. Completely free. Absolutely sovereign.

blocks.text: “Brilliant. So how do I get there?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Brilliant. So how do I get there?”

blocks.text: And that’s where you’ve already cocked it up.
blocks.directed: And that’s where you’ve already cocked it up.

blocks.text: Because the first thing we’re discussing is anupāya.
blocks.directed: Because the first thing we’re discussing is anupāya.

blocks.text: Literally, the method of no method.
blocks.directed: Literally, the method of no method.

blocks.text: Now, imagine someone who’s been absolutely struck by śaktipāta.
blocks.directed: Now, imagine someone who’s been absolutely struck by śaktipāta.

blocks.text: And I don’t mean they’ve had a nice meditation, felt a bit peaceful, and started calling themselves enlightened.
blocks.directed: And I don’t mean they’ve had a nice meditation, felt a bit peaceful, and started calling themselves enlightened.

blocks.text: I mean Śakti has hit them so profoundly that their entire understanding of reality is ready to turn inside out.
blocks.directed: I mean Śakti has hit them so profoundly that their entire understanding of reality is ready to turn inside out.

blocks.text: They hear it, comprehend what it actually means, and immediately recognise the truth.
blocks.directed: They hear it, comprehend what it actually means, and immediately recognise the truth.

blocks.text: No spending twelve years sitting in a cave trying to get your kuṇḍalinī to cooperate.
blocks.directed: No spending twelve years sitting in a cave trying to get your kuṇḍalinī to cooperate.

blocks.text: And the extraordinary thing is that this isn’t some temporary spiritual experience.
blocks.directed: And the extraordinary thing is that this isn’t some temporary spiritual experience.

blocks.text: Their samāveśa — immersion into divine consciousness — is nityodita.
blocks.directed: Their samāveśa — immersion into divine consciousness — is nityodita.

blocks.text: It doesn’t have to be repeatedly manufactured.
blocks.directed: It doesn’t have to be repeatedly manufactured.

blocks.text: “Abhinava, mate, didn’t you just say understanding and reasoning are part of yoga? Surely this person has used some kind of method?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Abhinava, mate, didn’t you just say understanding and reasoning are part of yoga? Surely this person has used some kind of method?”

blocks.text: If the supreme Lord, Parameśvara, is your own Self, svātmā, and is inherently self-luminous, svaprakāśa, what exactly is any method supposed to accomplish?
blocks.directed: If the supreme Lord, Parameśvara, is your own Self, svātmā, and is inherently self-luminous, svaprakāśa, what exactly is any method supposed to accomplish?

blocks.text: Possibility number one: You’re trying to attain your true nature.
blocks.directed: Possibility number one: You’re trying to attain your true nature.

blocks.text: But your true nature is eternal.
blocks.directed: But your true nature is eternal.

blocks.text: How are you going to acquire something that has never been absent?
blocks.directed: How are you going to acquire something that has never been absent?

blocks.text: It’s not a parcel arriving next Tuesday.
blocks.directed: It’s not a parcel arriving next Tuesday.

blocks.text: Possibility number two: You’re trying to make Śiva known.
blocks.directed: Possibility number two: You’re trying to make Śiva known.

blocks.text: It doesn’t require some second consciousness to come along and announce:
blocks.directed: [short pause] It doesn’t require some second consciousness to come along and announce:

blocks.text: The very awareness through which you’re attempting to discover Śiva is already the self-luminosity of Śiva.
blocks.directed: The very awareness through which you’re attempting to discover Śiva is already the self-luminosity of Śiva.

blocks.text: You’re trying to illuminate the illuminator.
blocks.directed: You’re trying to illuminate the illuminator.

blocks.text: Possibility number three: You’re trying to remove the veil covering Śiva.
blocks.directed: Possibility number three: You’re trying to remove the veil covering Śiva.

blocks.text: Because what exactly could cover the supreme consciousness?
blocks.directed: Because what exactly could cover the supreme consciousness?

blocks.text: All of these can appear only through consciousness.
blocks.directed: All of these can appear only through consciousness.

blocks.text: From the standpoint of Śiva’s unrestricted nature, there isn’t some independently existing veil capable of covering him.
blocks.directed: From the standpoint of Śiva’s unrestricted nature, there isn’t some independently existing veil capable of covering him.

blocks.text: Possibility number four: You’re trying to enter Śiva.
blocks.directed: Possibility number four: You’re trying to enter Śiva.

blocks.text: For there to be an entrance, you’d need someone standing outside and something waiting inside.
blocks.directed: For there to be an entrance, you’d need someone standing outside and something waiting inside.

blocks.text: You’re proposing to travel from Śiva to Śiva.
blocks.directed: You’re proposing to travel from Śiva to Śiva.

blocks.text: Bit of a pointless journey, isn’t it?
blocks.directed: Bit of a pointless journey, isn’t it?

blocks.text: And this brings us to the central absurdity.
blocks.directed: And this brings us to the central absurdity.

blocks.text: Even the method you propose using would have to exist within Śiva.
blocks.directed: Even the method you propose using would have to exist within Śiva.

blocks.text: So how could it stand apart from Śiva and take you to him?
blocks.directed: So how could it stand apart from Śiva and take you to him?

blocks.text: The whole bloody thing is Śiva already.
blocks.directed: The whole bloody thing is Śiva already.

blocks.text: And this consciousness is not divided by time.
blocks.directed: And this consciousness is not divided by time.

blocks.text: Ordinary instruments of knowledge cannot contain it.
blocks.directed: Ordinary instruments of knowledge cannot contain it.

blocks.text: Because time, space, forms, and the very instruments through which things are known arise through its own freedom.
blocks.directed: Because time, space, forms, and the very instruments through which things are known arise through its own freedom.

blocks.text: This reality isn’t waiting for permission from something else to exist.
blocks.directed: This reality isn’t waiting for permission from something else to exist.

blocks.text: And now comes the crucial recognition.
blocks.directed: And now comes the crucial recognition.

blocks.text: Not this little personality you’ve spent your whole life constructing.
blocks.directed: Not this little personality you’ve spent your whole life constructing.

blocks.text: Not merely your body, your biography, your opinions, or your collection of spiritual accomplishments.
blocks.directed: Not merely your body, your biography, your opinions, or your collection of spiritual accomplishments.

blocks.text: The self-luminous reality in which all of these appear.
blocks.directed: The self-luminous reality in which all of these appear.

blocks.text: Within the unrestricted awareness that I actually am.
blocks.directed: Within the unrestricted awareness that I actually am.

blocks.text: Now, when this is discerned with unshakeable certainty, there’s no further method necessary.
blocks.directed: Now, when this is discerned with unshakeable certainty, there’s no further method necessary.

blocks.text: The immersion in Parameśvara is already present.
blocks.directed: The immersion in Parameśvara is already present.

blocks.text: So for such a person, there is no compulsory dependence on mantra.
blocks.directed: So for such a person, there is no compulsory dependence on mantra.

blocks.text: No compulsory dependence on elaborate religious observances.
blocks.directed: No compulsory dependence on elaborate religious observances.

blocks.text: Not because these things are rubbish.
blocks.directed: Not because these things are rubbish.

blocks.text: We’ll discuss their value in subsequent chapters.
blocks.directed: We’ll discuss their value in subsequent chapters.

blocks.text: But because a means is unnecessary when the end is already fully realised.
blocks.directed: But because a means is unnecessary when the end is already fully realised.

blocks.text: And Abhinavagupta finishes with an absolutely beautiful image.
blocks.directed: And Abhinavagupta finishes with an absolutely beautiful image.

blocks.text: “Can a little clay pot be responsible for illuminating the thousand-rayed sun?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Can a little clay pot be responsible for illuminating the thousand-rayed sun?”

blocks.text: You could assemble every lamp, every candle, every instrument of illumination in the entire universe.
blocks.directed: You could assemble every lamp, every candle, every instrument of illumination in the entire universe.

blocks.text: None of them would contribute a single ray to the sun’s own radiance.
blocks.directed: None of them would contribute a single ray to the sun’s own radiance.

blocks.text: And likewise, no collection of spiritual techniques can produce the self-luminous Śiva.
blocks.directed: And likewise, no collection of spiritual techniques can produce the self-luminous Śiva.

blocks.text: For one who genuinely sees this, divine immersion is immediate.
blocks.directed: For one who genuinely sees this, divine immersion is immediate.

blocks.text: Not that you’ve finally found the perfect technique.
blocks.directed: Not that you’ve finally found the perfect technique.

blocks.text: But that there was never any distance to travel.
blocks.directed: But that there was never any distance to travel.
